mapper.sql: select w.work_order_id, w.work_order_no, w.source_order_no, w.school_name, w.style_id, s.style_name, w.material_batch_id, b.batch_no as material_batch_no, w.planned_quantity, w.completed_quantity, w.code_mode, w.order_status, w.qa_status, w.trace_status, w.trace_generated_count, w.planned_start_date, w.planned_end_date, w.actual_end_time, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time, w.remark from xf_work_order w left join xf_uniform_style s on w.style_id = s.style_id left join xf_material_batch b on w.material_batch_id = b.batch_id
mapper.insert: insert into xf_work_order( work_order_no, source_order_no, school_name, style_id, material_batch_id, planned_quantity, completed_quantity, code_mode, order_status, qa_status, trace_status, trace_generated_count, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, actual_end_time, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{workOrderNo}, #{sourceOrderNo}, #{schoolName}, #{styleId}, #{materialBatchId}, #{plannedQuantity}, #{completedQuantity}, #{codeMode}, #{orderStatus}, #{qaStatus}, #{traceStatus}, #{traceGeneratedCount}, #{plannedStartDate}, #{plannedEndDate}, #{actualEndTime}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update xf_work_order set completed_quantity = #{completedQuantity}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, qa_status = #{qaStatus}, trace_status = #{traceStatus}, trace_generated_count = #{traceGeneratedCount}, actual_end_time = #{actualEndTime}, update_time = sysdate() where work_order_id = #{workOrderId}
